claims.claim: A fit note is required if a health condition or disability affects capability for work for more than 7 days.
claims.quote: You must get a fit note (also known as a ‘sick note’) if your health condition or disability affects your capability to work for longer than 7 days.
claims.note: The health condition guide states this threshold.

claims.claim: Some exceptions apply to the fit note requirement.
claims.quote: You might not need to get a fit note if you’ve moved or are moving from Employment and Support Allowance ( ESA ) to Universal Credit .
claims.note: The guide gives a possible exception for people moving from ESA.
